headline: Against ALEPH's own simulation, same-sign muon pairs rise with mass with the same slope as opposite-sign pairs under both fills (pulls -0.57 and -0.09), while e mu pairs follow the simulation (Z 0.01). The rise is not opposite-sign only (S2 fails under both fills). Whether each rise alone reaches 2 sigma depends on the 20 simulation values hidden below the log axis (Z 2.10 / 2.25 with OFF -> 0, 1.68 / 1.41 with OFF -> 0.29), so D1 and S1 are reading-dependent.
meaning_applied: Amendment 0.26 sec. 8: S1 PASS would mean a muon-identification or fake-muon effect that ALEPH's simulation does not model. S1 is reading-dependent, so this meaning is NOT adopted as a result; it holds under the zero fill only. S2 FAIL under both fills: there is no sign that the rise is in opposite-sign pairs only. Amendment 0.28 removes the fill dependence (window where every value is readable) and turns the same-sign control into a constraint on the excess.
